tasks.description: 1.1 Implement the versioned assessment companion and document its input contract; verify schema parity, bounds, duplicate/internal-reference failures and historical revision handling without changing manifest v1.

1.2 Add shared exact resolution and component/claim/target/review cards through `result inspect`; verify conventional-only, unassessed, unresolved target and unchecked-adapter distinctions, including strict/closed and transcript/average differences.

1.3 Add revision/input/query-bound pagination and exact omission references; verify every row remains reachable, long Unicode fields fit both formats, stale cursors fail and complete input validation precedes selection.
1.4 Document and test the ordinary offline CLI, exit/stream behavior and JSON/text parity with subprocess/network guards.

2.1 Project exact stored checker receipts and canonical operation scopes using existing owners; verify candidate application, theorem replay, result-level build, missing evidence and mismatched/historical checking remain distinct from correspondence.

2.2 Integrate explicitly selected existing theorem dossier/lineage observations without refresh and preserve assumption origins, placeholders, obligations and unknown transitive coverage; verify fresh, stale, missing and partial-trust scenarios.
2.3 Document the evidence sections and exact drilldowns; verify inspection retains independent freshness, environment, observation, authority, completeness and review dimensions under truncation.

3.1 Exercise the installed command outside the checkout on fixtures and the immutable r44 exposition capture; retain converted attributed assessments, exact commands/output, resource measurements and qualitative friction without changing the original capture.

3.2 Run strict quality, relevant installed Python 3.11/3.12 contracts, OpenSpec/hygiene checks and an independent audit; record compatible prerequisite receipts and update the umbrella only for fully demonstrated outcomes.

instruction:
Recover the requested outcome and next useful result from the context files.
Work through tasks, run their completion checks, and record progress once.
Test consequential uncertain assumptions before expensive dependent work.
A failed probe stops expansion of that implementation; try a bounded alternative
within existing authorization, unchanged acceptance conditions, and the remaining
budget. Count all attempts against that budget. Keep capability tasks open until
their acceptance gates pass. Diagnose ordinary failures within scope; pause
when no viable authorized next step is available, naming the limiting dependency,
decision, or budget rather than treating one failed route as impossibility.
Report demonstrated outcomes and verification separately from checked tasks.
